methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.

actual_scope: Can the production k492-owner-repair hpe_audit_local.py used by emitted-local audits adopt the proved exact shared-denominator integer rows from research/emitted-local-integer-replay-seed90/ so that shipped local-replay path is faster while every receipt field stays identical, without editing SELECTED-SOURCE-bound sw4 checker copies?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after profiling leave-alone production rewrites and remaining proved opt-in adapters. Leave-alone objects (joint frames, shared-point, mixed-point, ternary, parity-side, R420 rref/geometry/mutants, frameopt.close, leech_minor, verify_factor #2194, sparse-fusion, joint-dual replay, quadratic-affine for #1076, data_corners #2320, clifford_exact #2329, bit-hosted-digest #2348, e8-bit-r420 MANIFEST-only edits) were skipped. Wiring into SELECTED-SOURCE-bound complex-sw4-frame8 hpe_audit_local.py copies was rejected to keep the selected inventory untouched. woklerx's merged #1184 opt-in adapter already proved ~2.33× on the complete selected R480 local audit with identical receipts; production research/complex-k492-owner-repair/code/hpe_audit_local.py still used Fraction-dict rows. This session wires that equivalent rewrite into the shipped k492 source, vendors pairwise baseline bytes, and demotes/retargets dependent VERIFY pins to the still-pairwise SELECTED-SOURCE sw4 checker.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: emitted local replay appears across cold/gauge construction tooling. A faster identical receipt does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving production hpe_audit_local.py integer-row change with frozen baseline, identical local-audit receipts, corruption controls, pin discipline, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not invent kappa, reopen leave-alone objects, or edit SELECTED-SOURCE-bound sw4 checker copies.
evidence: PASS_EMITTED_LOCAL_INTEGER_PRODUCTION via research/emitted-local-integer-production/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE; PASS_IDENTICAL_EMITTED_LOCAL_INTEGER_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via pinned-CPU benchmark.py --rounds 5 (median 7.080→3.131 s, 2.261×); complex-signed-prefix-audit and selected1094-wire-prefix-audit demote the k492 live pin and retarget to complex-sw4-frame8/local/hpe_audit_local.py; emitted-local-integer-replay-seed90 vendors baseline.py and regenerates CERTIFICATE sources.
